CATALOG.state: Existing frozen reference, not current Neon. Categories assumed fixed for synthetic worlds, not certified historic category assignments.

HISTORY.state: Frozen synthetic reference available. Real historic as-of states and availableAt need R02 audit. Never query real data merely to fill a design field.

PRICE.state: Applied synthetic prices and proposed prices are distinct. Product current values are not a dated history. price_events.csv contains relative reference changes, not actual RepuestoPro price lists.

QUOTE.state: No verified Bs/USD external source approved by this task. Never fill missing with 6.96 or transplant GBP/USD prices. CostsPage uses 6.96 as a UI default or reconstruction fallback. That is not evidence of a real historical quote. The API unitCost path can default an absent exchangeRate to 1, which must not be certified as a historical Bs/USD quote.

COST.state: Current UI flow treats Cost.costPrice as landed Bs/unit and unitCost request as USD/unit, with percentage markup. Existing records have no persisted native currency or raw USD field. Historical provenance still needs R02 audit, especially if exchangeRate is null or rows were edited.

STOCK.state: opening_stock at planned_at can support a synthetic cutoff if generator semantics verified. Current Inventory.stock cannot reconstruct historical stock. No persisted reservation fields are claimed.

ORDERS.state: No Prisma model for externally confirmed, pending customer purchase orders is asserted. Sale and SaleItem are completed sales, not this source. fulfilled_units/unmet_units at final outcome are excluded from predictors.

SUPPLY.state: Operational transfers and expectedDate do not certify international supplier lead times. Reconstruct pending at cutoff, never reuse the final received/pending fields as earlier state.

RECEIPTS.state: Receipts after cutoff are outcomes, never cutoff features. Only inspected sellable returns can enter stock. Real observation availability needs audit.

POLICY.state: Safety stock, order minimum, multiple and review cycle are not verified supplier rules. Inventory.minStock is not automatically any of these controls.

ASSUMPTION.state: User changes are hypotheses with assumedAsOf. Server recordedAt remains real audit time. No edits to operational facts or source certification.

CONTEXT.state: IDs, hashes, origin, model and snapshot versions supplied/verified by server. Not model quantities.

CALENDAR.state: America/La_Paz calendar, one-month objective, known before outcome.

DERIVED.state: Use only explicitly cited eligible inputs. A proposed formula is not an implemented pipeline or an empirical relationship.

OUTCOME.state: Label available after month close and observation certification. Late revisions require a new version, not silent rewriting.

MODEL_OUTPUT.state: Predictions, metrics and replenishment outputs never become features or observed sales automatically.

missing_semantics.UNKNOWN: No inferir cero, fecha de descarga o valor comercial. Registrar motivo y estado.
missing_semantics.STRUCTURALLY_NOT_APPLICABLE: Por ejemplo USD/flete cuando se fija costo Bs. No imputar como compra gratis.
missing_semantics.OBSERVED_ZERO: Solo cero medido o explícitamente simulado con periodo completo.

time_rules.cutoff: t0 = primer instante del mes objetivo en America/La_Paz. Horizonte [t0, inicio_mes_siguiente).
time_rules.history: Tres meses cerrados consecutivos t-3,t-2,t-1. No usar futuros reales del mes objetivo.
time_rules.fact_eligibility: Para REAL_AUDITED, event_at y available_at válidos según semántica y available_at <= t0. Antigüedad del evento no demuestra conocimiento.
time_rules.hypothetical_eligibility: assumed_as_of=t0 no convierte la hipótesis en un hecho histórico. recorded_at refleja la consulta/construcción real.
time_rules.planned_events: Un efecto posterior puede ser feature de plan solo si se conoce/supone antes de t0. No usar entregas o precios observados después.
time_rules.intervals: Intervalos semiabiertos [desde,hasta), sin huecos ni solapamientos en precios requeridos. Cambio a mediodía implica fracción de día.
time_rules.quote_age: floor((cutoff_instant - observed_quote_instant).total_seconds() / 86400), nonnegative, preserving (start - observed_at).days in generate_calibrated_v1_1.py. Not subtraction of calendar date labels. Reject a quote observed after cutoff.
time_rules.annulments: Ventas reales requieren estado as-of auditable. Si no puede reconstruirse, declarar historia no certificable. Un label corregido después exige versión nueva.
time_rules.price_coverage: Ponderaciones solo con intervalos que cubren todo el mes. Con huecos/desconocimiento, null. KEEP no certifica que no habrá cambios. Mantener precio base todo el mes exige plan explícito o hipótesis registrada, no ausencia de eventos.

integrity_rules: Claves únicas por tabla y claves foráneas entre escenario, producto, tienda, evento y origen.
No duplicar un mismo pedido, envío o recepción al unir tablas.
Total histórico bruto = menor + mayor + modalidad desconocida, sin restar devoluciones.
Reservas físicas dentro y después del horizonte no superan stock vendible.
Pendiente a corte = enviado conocido antes de t0 menos recepciones anteriores conocidas. Nunca restar recepciones futuras.
Necesidad de reposición usa compromiso como piso y no resta reservas del mismo horizonte dos veces.
Mínimos, múltiplos, revisión y seguridad son controles, no features automáticas.
No generar features con label, demanda latente o salidas del modelo.
Las 16 columnas ampliadas son candidatas, no demuestran mecanismos identificados o selección final.

evaluation_rules.split: Meses completos cronológicos, sin split aleatorio.
evaluation_rules.families: Variantes de un mismo escenario no son observaciones independientes. Registrar familia y stream, evitar duplicados idénticos y auditar separación de realizaciones en evaluación.
evaluation_rules.test: No reutilizar TEST consumido 2.2 para selección, tuning o nueva prueba independiente. Un cambio de nombre no crea un TEST nuevo.
evaluation_rules.sources: Monash/UCI/M5/Favorita solo patrones bajo condiciones registradas. No filas externas convertidas a ventas reales mediante cambio de IDs.

cost_reconciliation.current_implementation: money(unitCost * exchangeRate * (1 + percentage / 100)). UI treats input as USD and stored costPrice as landed Bs. Product.cost is synced from latest Cost.costPrice.
cost_reconciliation.scenario_contract: SIMULATE_IMPORT_USD: unitCostUsd * bsPerUsd + freightPerUnitBs + otherPerUnitBs. SET_LANDED_COST_BS: use already landed Bs directly.
cost_reconciliation.equivalence_condition: A verified percentage component may be represented as otherPerUnitBs = unitCostUsd * bsPerUsd * percentage / 100 only if its origin/components are known. Never add it again to already landed costPrice.
cost_reconciliation.historical_unknowns: No inverse reconstruction of missing USD, rate or components from default 6.96, 1 or an edited current price. Keep null/source UNKNOWN.

eligibility_rules.supervised_training_row: Requires complete prior three months, valid known-at-cutoff inputs under selected feature policy, non-null nonnegative integer target after close, unique key and explicit origin. No monthly target imputation.
eligibility_rules.scenario_request_without_outcome: Can be a hypothetical UI scenario with null target, never a trainable supervised row.
eligibility_rules.invalid_adversarial_payload: Keep separate validator fixtures/rejection logs, never insert negative prices/quantities into valid training tables. Adverse valid stockouts or zeros stay labeled truthfully.
eligibility_rules.role_of_price_and_cost: Nonnegative cost can be explicitly zero, unknown cost is null. Prices and rate strictly positive when edited. No hidden below-cost correction.
eligibility_rules.partial_stock_observation: Observed historical zero-stock days can be a lower bound when coverage <1. Coverage 0 gives null days, not zero.
eligibility_rules.order_overlap: Known commitments form a conservative floor in replenishment, not a proof that all wholesale units are incremental. Flag overlap uncertainty.

identity_hierarchy.scenario_id: Identifica una comparación de producto/tienda/mes y sus hipótesis. El backend asigna el ID. No reutilizarlo para otra petición diferente.
identity_hierarchy.realization_id: Mundo temporal reproducible que conecta historia, pedidos, precios y resultados. Variantes no son observaciones independientes.
identity_hierarchy.scenario_family_id: Familia de variantes pareadas para auditar dependencia y separación de evaluación. No es una feature.
identity_hierarchy.history_link: Las tres filas históricas de cada comparación proceden del mismo mundo/versionado. Compartir historial no autoriza duplicar observaciones para inflar el tamaño muestral.

feature_selection_risks: Precios base, ponderados y variaciones son parcialmente derivables entre sí. Comparar grupos y redundancia, no imponer todas las columnas.
Cotización, costo y precio pueden estar correlacionados por una trayectoria económica común. No contar cada producto como una observación económica independiente.
Plazos, entradas y reservas solo se aceptan si existen o se asumen antes de t0. No inferirlos de resultados posteriores.
Los 33 FEATURE de la proyección son candidatos, no selección final. El docente pide considerar su función y justificarla, no forzar un efecto ficticio.
Un mecanismo sintético de sensibilidad debe declararse y probarse en R03. Una métrica sintética buena no certifica elasticidad comercial.
